column2: Once you determine the cost to cast The Capitoline Triad, you may activate mana abilities to pay that cost
column3: the engine lacks the behavior: its payment planner activates only tap mana abilities, so no mana ability with a sacrifice or mill cost (Krark-Clan Ironworks, Deranged Assistant) can put a historic card into the graveyard between the cost's determination (CR 601.2f) and its payment (601.2h); a planner for such abilities is not a small fix (rulings-P100)
